name: add_attachment
description:
Add an attachment to an issue from a file path.

Creates a new attachment associated with the specified issue by reading
a file from the filesystem. Automatically handles MIME type detection,
file size validation, encoding, and checksum generation. The attachment
is stored in the database with full metadata and the issue is updated
to reference the new attachment.

issue_id_or_key.description:
The unique identifier or key of the target issue.
Must be a non-empty string that exists in the database.

file_path.description:
Filesystem path to the file to attach. The file will
be read from disk and the filename will be extracted from the path.

name: assign_issue_to_user
description:
Assign an issue to a user.

        This method assigns an issue to a specific user. The assignee can be
a user or can be set to 'Unassigned' or empty string to unassign the issue.

issue_id.description: The unique identifier of the issue to assign.

assignee.description: The assignee information. Can be empty to unassign.

name.description: The assignee's username (e.g., 'jdoe'). Use 'Unassigned' or empty string '' to unassign the issue. None values are normalized to 'Unassigned'.

name: bulk_delete_issues
description:
Delete multiple issues in bulk.

        This method validates all issue IDs first and deletes them in a single operation.
If any issue IDs are invalid or do not exist, all invalid IDs will be reported in the error message.

issue_ids.description: A list of issue IDs to delete. All IDs must reference existing issues.

name: create_group
description:
Create a new group.

This method creates a new group with the specified name. The group
will initially have no members.

name.description: The name of the group to create. Cannot be empty or whitespace-only.

name: create_issue
description:
Create a new issue in Zira.

        This method creates a new issue with the specified fields. The issue will be
        assigned a unique ID and stored in the system. Only project and summary are
required fields.

fields.description: A dictionary containing the issue fields.

project.description: The project key the issue belongs to. Must reference an existing project. Cannot be empty or whitespace-only. Normalized to uppercase before lookup.

summary.description: A brief one-line description of the issue. Cannot be empty or whitespace-only.

issuetype.description: The issue type ID (e.g., 'BUG', 'TASK', 'STORY', 'SUBTASK'). Must reference a valid issue_types ID in the database. Defaults to 'TASK' if not provided.

description.description: A detailed description of the issue. Defaults to empty string if not provided.

priority.description: The priority ID of the issue (e.g., 'Highest', 'High', 'Medium', 'Low', 'Lowest'). Must reference a valid priorities ID in the database. Defaults to 'Low' if not provided.

status.description: The status ID of the issue (e.g., 'To Do', 'Open', 'In Progress', 'Resolved', 'Closed', 'Done'). Must reference a valid statuses ID in the database. Defaults to 'Open' if not provided.

assignee.description: The user assigned to the issue. Must be an object with 'name' key. Defaults to {'name': 'Unassigned'} if not provided.

components.description: IDs of Components associated with the issue. Each component must exist and belong to the project.

due_date.description: The due date of the issue. Supported formats: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY. Normalized to YYYY-MM-DD.

comments.description: A list of comments to add to the issue.

created.description: The creation timestamp in ISO format (e.g., '2025-07-09T10:30:00'). Defaults to current timestamp if not provided.

labels.description: A list of labels/tags for the issue (e.g., ["bug", "urgent"]).

resolution.description: The resolution ID of the issue (e.g., "RES-1", "RES-2"). Use get_all_resolutions to retrieve available resolution IDs. Defaults to None if not provided.

startDate.description: The date when work on the issue started. Supported formats: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY. Normalized to YYYY-MM-DD.

closedDate.description: The date when the issue was closed. Supported formats: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY. Normalized to YYYY-MM-DD.

parent.description: The ID of the parent issue if this is a subtask. Must belong to the same project as the issue. Example: "ISSUE-1".

fixVersion.description: List of target fix versions. Each version must exist and belong to the same project as the issue.

affectedVersion.description: List of affected versions. Each version must exist and belong to the same project as the issue.

name: create_issue_link
description:
Create a new issue link in Zira.

This method creates a new issue link between two issues. The link will be
assigned a unique ID and stored in the system. Both issues must exist in
the database for the link to be created successfully. A link of the same
type cannot already exist between the two issues in either direction.

type.description: The type of issue link to create. Valid types are determined by the system configuration (e.g., 'Blocks', 'Duplicates'). The available types can be retrieved from the issue_link_types database.

key.description: The key of the inward issue. Must be a non-empty string.
The key of the outward issue. Must be a non-empty string.

name: create_issue_type
description:
Create a new issue type in Zira.

This method creates a new issue type with the specified name and description.
The issue type's ID can be optionally specified; otherwise, the name is used as the ID.

description.description: The description of the issue type. Cannot be empty if provided.

type.description: The type of issue type. Use 'subtask' to create a subtask type, or 'standard' for a regular issue type.

name.description: The name of the issue type. Cannot be empty. Must be unique.

id.description: The unique identifier. If not provided, name is used. Stored as uppercase.

name: create_project
description:
Create a new project.

This method creates a new project with the given key and name.
Optionally, a project lead can be assigned.

proj_key.description: The key of the project. Must be a non-empty string. Normalized to uppercase before storage to match the ZiraProject DB contract.

proj_name.description: The name of the project. Must be a non-empty string.

proj_lead.description: The name of the project lead. Must be a valid user name if provided.

name: create_project_component
description:
Create a new component in a Zira project.

This method creates a new component within a specified project. Components
are used to group issues within a project and can be assigned to specific
team members.

project.description: The key of the project where the component will be created. Must be a non-empty string. Normalized to uppercase before lookup.

name.description: The name of the component. Must be a non-empty string with a maximum length of 255 characters.

description.description: A description of the component's purpose. Maximum length is 1000 characters.

owner.description: The username of the component owner/lead. If provided, must be a valid user in the system.

name: create_user
description:
Create a new user with all required fields.

Validates the input payload and creates a user object with the provided
data and sensible defaults.

payload.description: A dictionary containing the user's details.

name.description: The username for the new user.

emailAddress.description: The user's primary email address. The email address is normalized by stripping whitespace and converting to lowercase before storage. This ensures consistent duplicate detection and lookup.

displayName.description: The name to display in the UI. If not provided, defaults to the username.

joined.description: The date the user joined in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format (e.g., '2022-01-15'). Cannot be a future date.

groups.description: A list of group names. Each must reference an existing group.

theme.description: UI theme preference. One of 'light' (default light theme), 'dark' (dark mode), 'auto' (follow system preference). Defaults to 'light'.

notifications.description: The user's notification preference. Defaults to True.

name: create_version
description:
Create a new version.

Creates a new version for a project. Versions help organize issues by release
cycle and track progress toward releases.

name.description: The name of the version. Required.

project.description: The project key/ID this version belongs to. Required. Normalized to uppercase before lookup.

release_date.description: The release date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

id.description: Custom ID for the version. Auto-generated if not provided.

move_unfixed_issues_to.description: URL for moving unfixed issues. Auto-generated if not provided.

start_date.description: The start date of the version in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: create_webhooks
description:
Create new webhooks in the system.

This method creates new webhooks with the provided configurations. Each webhook
will be assigned a unique ID and stored in the system. Webhooks are used to
receive notifications when specific events occur in Zira.

webhooks.description: A list of webhook configurations to create. Must contain at least one webhook.

url.description: The HTTP endpoint URL that will receive webhook POST requests. Must start with http:// or https://.

events.description: List of event types to subscribe to. Valid: issue_created, issue_updated, issue_deleted, issue_assigned, project_created, project_updated, project_deleted, user_created, user_updated, user_deleted. Note: Duplicate event names are automatically deduplicated.

name: crop_temporary_avatar
description:
Crop a temporary avatar in Zira.

This method allows cropping a temporary avatar to the desired dimensions
before making it permanent. This is typically used after uploading a
temporary avatar to adjust its appearance.

avatar_id.description: The unique identifier of the temporary avatar to crop. Must reference an existing temporary avatar.

cropDimensions.description: A dictionary containing the crop dimensions.

x.description: The x-coordinate of the top-left corner (must be >= 0).

y.description: The y-coordinate of the top-left corner (must be >= 0).

width.description: The width of the crop area (must be > 0).

height.description: The height of the crop area (must be > 0).

name: delete_attachment
description:
Delete an attachment and remove all references from issues.

Permanently removes an attachment from the system, including the file data
and all references to it from issues. This operation cannot be undone.
The function performs a complete cleanup by removing both the attachment
record and all issue references to ensure data consistency.

id.description:
The unique identifier of the attachment to delete.
Must be a positive integer or a string representation of a positive integer.

name: delete_component_by_id
description:
Delete a component from a project.

This method permanently removes a component from a project. Optionally,
issues assigned to the component can be moved to another component.

comp_id.description: The unique identifier of the component to delete. Format: 'CMP-{number}'.

moveIssuesTo.description: The ID of the component to move existing issues to. Format: 'CMP-{number}'. If not provided, issues will remain unassigned.

name: delete_group_by_name
description:
Delete an existing group.

This method permanently removes a group from the system. All users
in the group will lose their group-based permissions. Exactly one of groupname or groupId must be provided.

groupname.description: The name of the group to delete (case-insensitive). Cannot be used with groupId parameter. Cannot be empty or whitespace-only.

groupId.description: The ID of the group to delete. Cannot be used with groupname parameter. Cannot be empty or whitespace-only.

name: delete_issue_by_id
description:
Delete an existing issue.

This method permanently removes an issue from the system and performs a cascade delete
to maintain database consistency by automatically removing all associated attachments
and issue links. Optionally, subtasks can also be deleted based on the delete_subtasks parameter.

issue_id.description: The unique identifier of the issue to delete.

delete_subtasks.description: Whether to delete subtasks. If False and subtasks exist, deletion fails. Defaults to False.

name: delete_project_by_key
description:
Delete a project.

This method deletes a project and all its associated components, issues, versions, and project avatars.

project_key.description: The key of the project. Must be a non-empty string.

name: delete_user_by_username_or_key
description:
Delete a user by username or key.

Deletes a user from the database. If username is provided, attempts to look up
the user's key first. If username lookup fails but a key was also provided,
falls back to using the key parameter. Performs integrity checks before deletion.
Prevents deletion if the user owns or is assigned to any records.

username.description: The username of the user to delete. Cannot be an empty string. If provided, the function attempts username lookup first, with fallback to key if available. One of username or key must be provided.

key.description: The key (account_id) of the user to delete. Cannot be an empty string. Used as fallback if username lookup fails, or used directly if username is not provided. One of username or key must be provided.

name: delete_version_by_id
description: Delete a version. Optionally move issues referencing this version to another version.

ver_id.description: The ID of the version to delete. Cannot be empty.

move_fix_issues_to.description: The ID of the version to move fixed issues to. If provided, all issues with this version as fixVersion will have it replaced with the target version.

move_affected_issues_to.description: The ID of the version to move affected issues to. If provided, all issues with this version as affectedVersion will have it replaced with the target version.

name: delete_webhooks_by_ids
description:
Delete webhooks by their IDs.

This method deletes one or more webhooks identified by their IDs.

webhookIds.description: The IDs of the webhooks to delete. Must contain at least one ID.

name: download_attachment
description:
Download attachment content to a local file in the current directory.

Downloads the specified attachment and saves it to the current directory using
the attachment's original filename. This function handles both binary and text
attachments based on the attachment's stored encoding format ('base64' or 'text').

The function retrieves the attachment data directly from the database and
then processes it according to its encoding:
- Base64 encoded attachments (binary files) are decoded and written as binary files
- Text encoded attachments are written as UTF-8 text files

id.description:
The unique identifier of the attachment to download.
Can be provided as an integer or string representation of the attachment ID.
Must be a positive integer that exists in the database.

name: find_groups_for_picker
description:
Search for groups matching a query string.

This method searches for groups whose names contain the specified query string.
Supports filtering by user membership, exclusions by name or ID, case sensitivity,
and pagination via maxResults.

query.description: The search string to match against group names. If None or empty, all groups will be returned.

exclude.description: Group names to exclude from results. Cannot be used together with excludeId parameter.

items.description: Group name to exclude from results. Must be a list of valid group names.

excludeId.description: Group IDs to exclude from results. Cannot be used together with exclude parameter.

items.description: Group ID to exclude from results. Must be a list of valid group IDs.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of groups to return. Must be between 1 and 1000. Defaults to 20.

caseInsensitive.description: Whether the query search should be case-insensitive. Defaults to False (case-sensitive) to match Zira API behavior.

accountId.description: The account ID (UUID key) of the user to find groups for. Returns only groups that contain this user. Cannot be empty or whitespace-only if provided.

name: find_users
description:
Finds users by a string search against their name, display name, and email.

Provides a general-purpose search for users with pagination and filtering
by active status. The search is case-insensitive.

search_string.description: The search string to match against user fields (name, displayName, email). Cannot be empty or whitespace-only.

startAt.description: The index of the first user to return. Must be non-negative.

maxResults.description: The maximum number of users to return. Must be between 1 and 1000.

includeActive.description: If True, active users are included in results.

includeInactive.description: If True, inactive users are included in results.

name: get_all_dashboards
description:
Retrieve a list of dashboards from Zira.

This method returns a list of all dashboards in the system, with optional
pagination support. Dashboards are used to display various Zira data and
metrics in a customizable layout.

startAt.description: The index of the first dashboard to return. Must be non-negative.

maxResults.description: The maximum number of dashboards to return. Must be positive if provided. If not specified, all dashboards will be returned.

name: get_all_filters
description:
Retrieve all filters from Zira.

This method returns a list of all filters in the system. Filters in Zira
are used to save and share search queries, allowing users to quickly
access commonly used issue searches.

name: get_all_issue_link_types
description:
Retrieve all issue link types from Zira.

This method returns a list of all issue link types defined in the system.
Issue link types are used to categorize and manage relationships between issues.

name: get_all_issue_types
description:
Retrieve all issue types from Zira.

This method returns a list of all issue types defined in the system.
Issue types are used to categorize and manage issues in Zira.

name: get_all_permission_schemes
description:
Get all permission schemes.

This method returns all permission schemes in the system.

name: get_all_permissions
description:
Get the system-wide issue permission flags configured in the Zira system.

Returns whether issue creation, editing, and deletion are enabled in the system.

name: get_all_priorities
description:
Get all priorities configured in the Zira system.

This method returns all priorities available for use in issue creation and updates.
Priorities indicate the importance or urgency level of issues, helping teams
prioritize their work effectively.

name: get_all_project_categories
description:
Get all project categories.

This method returns all project categories configured in the system.

name: get_all_projects
description:
Get all projects.

This method returns all projects in the system.

name: get_all_resolutions
description:
Get all resolutions configured in the Zira system.

This method returns all resolutions available for use when closing issues.
Resolutions indicate how an issue was resolved, such as 'Fixed', 'Won't Fix',
or 'Duplicate'.

name: get_all_roles
description:
Get all roles.

This method returns all roles in the system, including both project roles
and application roles. If no roles exist, the 'roles' array will be empty.

name: get_all_security_levels
description:
Get all security levels.

This method returns all security levels configured in the Zira system.
Security levels are used to restrict access to issues based on user permissions.
If no security levels exist, an empty list is returned.

name: get_all_settings
description:
Retrieve all unique user settings from the system.

This method returns all unique settings across all users. Settings include
user preferences like theme and notification options.

name: get_all_status_categories
description:
Get all status categories.

This method returns all status categories configured in the Zira system.
Status categories group related statuses together and determine their
visual representation in Zira.

name: get_all_statuses
description:
Get all workflow statuses configured in the Zira system.

This method returns all statuses available in the system. Statuses represent
the possible states an issue can be in during its workflow lifecycle.

name: get_all_webhooks
description:
Retrieve all webhooks from the system.

This method returns all webhooks currently configured in the system.

name: get_all_workflows
description:
Retrieve all workflows from Zira.

This method returns all workflows in the system. Workflows define
how issues move through different statuses from creation to completion.

name: get_application_properties
description:
Retrieve application properties from Zira.

This method allows fetching either all application properties or a specific property
by its key.

key.description: The key of the specific property to retrieve. If not provided, all application properties will be returned. Examples: 'siteName', 'maintenanceMode'. Case-sensitive.

permissionLevel.description: The permission level to filter accessible properties. Must be one of: 'ADMIN' (returns all properties), 'USER' (returns non-admin properties), or 'ANONYMOUS' (returns only public properties). If not provided, all properties are returned.

keyFilter.description: A substring filter for property keys. Only properties whose keys contain this substring (case-insensitive) will be returned. Ignored if 'key' is provided.

name: get_application_role_by_key
description:
Retrieve a specific application role by its key.

This method returns detailed information about a specific application role
identified by its unique key.

key.description: The unique identifier of the application role to retrieve.

name: get_application_roles
description:
Retrieve all application roles from Zira.

This method returns a list of all application roles defined in the system.
Application roles are used to control access to specific Zira features and functionality.

name: get_attachment_content
description:
Get attachment content from the database.

Retrieves the attachment content. If the attachment record exists but has no content
(null or missing), returns an empty string.
All attachments are stored as base64-encoded strings for consistency and JSON
serializability. Use base64 decoding on the returned content to get the original
file data.

id.description:
The unique identifier of the attachment to retrieve.
Can be provided as an integer or string representation of the attachment ID.
Must be a positive integer that exists in the database.

name: get_attachment_metadata
description:
Get attachment metadata without file content.

Returns metadata information for an attachment.
This is useful for getting file information (name, size, type, etc.)

id.description:
The unique identifier of the attachment. Must be a positive
integer or a string representation of a positive integer.

name: get_authenticated_user
description:
Get the currently authenticated user for the Zira session.

Returns identity details when a user is authenticated, or authenticated=False when no
current user is set.

name: get_component_by_id
description:
Retrieve a component by its ID.

This method returns detailed information about a specific component
identified by its unique ID.

comp_id.description: The unique identifier of the component to retrieve. Format: 'CMP-{number}'.

name: get_current_user_permissions
description:
Get the current user's permissions.

This method returns the permissions of the current user from the database.
The permissions are returned as a list of permission keys that the user has access to.

name: get_current_user_preferences
description:
Get the current user's preferences.

Returns the stored theme and notification preference values.

name: get_dashboard_by_id
description:
Retrieve a specific dashboard by its ID.

This method returns detailed information about a specific dashboard
identified by its unique ID.

dash_id.description: The unique identifier of the dashboard to retrieve. Cannot be empty or whitespace-only.

name: get_filter_by_id
description:
Retrieve a specific filter by its ID.

This method returns detailed information about a specific filter
identified by its unique ID.

filter_id.description: The unique identifier of the filter to retrieve. Cannot be empty.

name: get_group_by_name
description:
Retrieve a specific group by its name or ID.

This method returns detailed information about a specific group
identified by either its name or groupId.
Exactly one of groupname or groupId must be provided.

groupname.description: The name of the group to retrieve (case-insensitive). Cannot be empty or whitespace-only.

groupId.description: The ID of the group to retrieve. Cannot be empty or whitespace-only.

name: get_issue_by_id
description:
Retrieve a specific issue by its ID.

        This method returns detailed information about a specific issue
identified by its unique ID, including any attachments associated with the issue.

issue_id.description: The unique identifier of the issue to retrieve (e.g., "ISSUE-1").

name: get_issue_create_metadata
description:
Get the create metadata for projects and issue types.

        This method returns metadata about projects and their available issue types
        that can be used for creating new issues. The response can be filtered by
project keys and issue type names.

projectKeys.description: Comma-separated project keys to filter results. If None, all projects returned. Non-existent keys are silently ignored.

issueTypeNames.description: Comma-separated issue type names to filter results. If None, all types returned. Case-insensitive. Non-existent types are silently ignored.

name: get_issue_link_type_by_id
description:
Retrieve a specific issue link type by its ID.

This method returns detailed information about a specific issue link type
identified by its unique ID.

link_type_id.description: The unique identifier of the issue link type to retrieve. Cannot be empty.

name: get_issue_type_by_id
description:
Retrieve a specific issue type by its ID.

This method returns detailed information about a specific issue type
identified by its unique ID.

type_id.description: The unique identifier of the issue type to retrieve. Cannot be empty.

name: get_jql_autocomplete_suggestions
description:
Retrieve JQL (Zira Query Language) autocomplete data for query assistance.

This method returns autocomplete suggestions that help users construct valid JQL queries.
The data includes available field names, operators, and reserved words that can be used
in JQL expressions for searching and filtering issues in Zira.

name: get_permission_scheme_by_id
description:
Get a permission scheme by id.

This method returns a permission scheme by id from the database.

scheme_id.description: The unique identifier of the permission scheme to retrieve. Cannot be empty.

name: get_priority_by_id
description:
Get a specific priority by its ID.

This method retrieves detailed information about a single priority identified
by its unique ID. Use this to validate priority IDs or get priority details
for display purposes.

priority_id.description: The unique identifier of the priority to retrieve. Must be a non-empty string matching an existing priority ID in the database. Examples: 'High', 'Medium', 'Low'. Case-sensitive.

name: get_project_avatars_by_key
description:
Get all avatars for a project.

This function returns all avatars with type 'project' that belong to the given project key.
Avatars without a project_key field are treated as shared and returned for all projects.

project_key.description: The key of the project. Must be a non-empty string.

name: get_project_by_key
description:
Get a project by key.

This method retrieves a specific project using its key.

project_key.description: The key of the project. Must be a non-empty string.

name: get_project_category_by_id
description:
Get a specific project category by its ID.

This method retrieves detailed information about a single project category
identified by its unique ID.

cat_id.description: The unique identifier of the project category to retrieve (e.g., 'CAT-1'). Case-sensitive.

name: get_project_components_by_key
description:
Get all components for a project.

This method returns all components for a project.

project_key.description: The key of the project. Must be a non-empty string.

name: get_reindex_status
description:
Get the current status of the reindex operation.

This method returns comprehensive information about any ongoing or completed reindex operation,
including progress details, timestamps, and configuration. Historical data is preserved.

name: get_resolution_by_id
description:
Get a specific resolution by its ID.

This method retrieves detailed information about a single resolution identified
by its unique ID. Use this to validate resolution IDs or get resolution details
for display purposes.

res_id.description: The unique identifier of the resolution to retrieve. Must be a non-empty string matching an existing resolution ID in the database. Examples: 'RES-1', 'RES-2'. Case-sensitive.

name: get_role_by_id
description:
Get a role by id.

This method returns a role by id, searching both project roles and application roles.
If the role is not found, a ValueError is raised.

role_id.description: The unique identifier of the role to retrieve. Must be a non-empty string. For project roles, use IDs like R-1, R-2. For application roles, use keys like admin, user. Cannot be empty or whitespace-only.

name: get_security_level_by_id
description:
Get a security level by its ID.

This method retrieves detailed information about a single security level
identified by its unique ID. Use this to validate security level IDs or
get security level details for display purposes.

sec_id.description: The unique identifier of the security level to retrieve. Must be a non-empty string matching an existing security level ID in the database. Case-sensitive.

name: get_server_info
description:
Get server information.

Retrieves comprehensive server information including version, URLs, build details,
and current server time. This endpoint provides essential metadata about the
Zira server instance.

name: get_status_by_id
description:
Get a specific workflow status by its ID.

This method retrieves detailed information about a single status identified
by its unique ID. Use this to validate status IDs or get status details
for display purposes.

status_id.description: The unique identifier of the status to retrieve. Must be a non-empty string matching an existing status ID in the database. Examples: 'Open', 'Closed'. Case-sensitive.

name: get_status_category_by_id
description:
Get a status category by its ID.

This method retrieves detailed information about a single status category
identified by its unique ID. Use this to validate status category IDs or
get status category details for display purposes.

cat_id.description: The unique identifier of the status category to retrieve. Must be a non-empty string matching an existing status category ID in the database. Case-sensitive.

name: get_user_avatars_by_username
description:
Get all avatars for a user.

This function returns all avatars with type 'user' that belong to the given username.
Avatars associated with a project (having a non-null project_key) are excluded from the results.
Avatars without a username field are treated as shared and returned for all users.

username.description: The username of the user whose avatars to retrieve. Must be a non-empty string.

name: get_user_by_username_or_account_id
description:
Get a user by username or account_id(key).

Retrieves a single user from the database. If account_id is provided, the lookup
is exclusive (no fallback to username). Groups are dynamically computed from DB["groups"].

username.description: The username of the user to retrieve. Only one of username or account_id should be provided.

account_id.description: The account ID (key) of the user to retrieve. Only one of username or account_id should be provided.

name: get_version_by_id
description: Get a version by ID.

ver_id.description: The ID of the version to get. Cannot be empty.

name: get_version_related_issue_counts_by_id
description: Get the related issue counts for a version.

ver_id.description: The ID of the version to get issue counts for. Cannot be empty.

name: list_issue_attachments
description:
List all attachments associated with an issue.

Retrieves metadata for all attachments that are currently associated with the
specified issue. The function automatically handles orphaned references by
skipping attachments that were deleted but still have references in the issue.
Returns an empty list if the issue has no attachments. The attachments are
returned in the order they appear in the issue's attachment list.

issue_id_or_key.description:
The unique identifier or key of the issue to query.
Must be a non-empty string that exists in the database.

name: perform_bulk_issue_operations
description:
Performs bulk operations on multiple Zira issues.

This function allows updating multiple issues in a single operation.
Each update can modify fields including: assignee, status, priority, summary, description, labels, resolution, startDate, closedDate, project, components, issuetype, parent, due_date, comments, fixVersion, and affectedVersion.
Additionally, issues can be deleted with optional subtask deletion.

issueUpdates.description: A list of issue updates to perform.

items.description: A single issue update entry. Supports field-level updates, direct property overrides, and delete operations.

issueId.description: The ID of the issue to update or delete.

fields.description: Fields to update. Individual field parameters take precedence.

priority.description: New priority ID (e.g., 'Highest', 'High', 'Medium', 'Low', 'Lowest'). Must reference a valid priorities ID in the database.

status.description: New status ID (e.g., 'To Do', 'Open', 'In Progress', 'Resolved', 'Closed', 'Done'). Must reference a valid statuses ID in the database.

issuetype.description: New issue type ID (e.g., 'BUG', 'TASK', 'STORY', 'SUBTASK'). Must reference a valid issue_types ID in the database.

project.description: New project key. Normalized to uppercase before lookup.

due_date.description: Due date. Supported formats: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY.

resolution.description: Resolution ID (e.g., 'RES-1', 'RES-2'). Must reference a valid resolutions ID in the database. Use get_all_resolutions to retrieve available IDs.

startDate.description: Start date. Supported formats: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY.

closedDate.description: Closed date. Supported formats: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY.

parent.description: The parent issue ID for subtasks. Must belong to the same project as the issue. Set to update the parent relationship.

fixVersion.description: List of target fix versions. Each version must exist and belong to the same project as the issue. REPLACES all existing fix versions. Pass an empty list to clear.

items.description: A version reference containing the version ID.

affectedVersion.description: List of affected versions. Each version must exist and belong to the same project as the issue. REPLACES all existing affected versions. Pass an empty list to clear.

items.description: A version reference containing the version ID.

status.description: Direct status ID (takes precedence over fields.status). Must reference a valid statuses ID in the database.

priority.description: Direct priority ID (takes precedence over fields.priority). Must reference a valid priorities ID in the database.

resolution.description: Direct resolution ID (takes precedence over fields.resolution). Must reference a valid resolutions ID in the database.

deleteSubtasks.description: Whether to delete subtasks when deleting.

name: search_issues_for_picker
description:
Search for issues based on a query string and/or JQL.

This method searches for issues based on a text query string and/or JQL (Zira Query Language).
The search is case-insensitive for text queries. JQL filtering is applied first, then text filtering.

query.description: Text query to search in issue summaries and IDs. Case-insensitive. None means no text filtering. Empty string matches all.

currentJQL.description: JQL expression to filter issues before text search. Valid searchable fields: id, project, summary, description, issuetype, status, priority, assignee, labels, components, resolution, parent, created, updated, due_date, startDate, closedDate. Field names must match exactly as listed. Using any other field will raise a ValueError. Quoting rule: a literal value may be passed unquoted only if it consists solely of letters, digits, underscore (_), or dot (.). Any value containing other characters (spaces, hyphens, slashes, colons, etc.) MUST be enclosed in single (') or double (") quotes. This includes values with spaces, values with hyphens such as issue keys, component IDs, resolution IDs, and parent keys (e.g., id = "ISSUE-4", id IN ("ISSUE-4", "DEMO-99"), components IN ("CMP-1", "CMP-2")), and date values (e.g., created >= "2024-01-01"). Plain alphanumeric values (e.g., status = Open, priority IN (High, Low), project = DEMO) may be passed unquoted; quoting them is also accepted.

currentIssueKey.description: Issue key to exclude from results. Cannot be empty if provided.

showSubTasks.description: Whether to include subtasks. If False, issues with issuetype "Subtask" are excluded.

name: search_issues_jql
description: Search for issues based on JQL query.

jql.description:
The JQL query to search for issues. If None or empty, returns all accessible issues.
Quoting rule: a literal value may be passed unquoted only if it consists solely of letters,
digits, underscore (`_`), or dot (`.`). Any value containing other characters (spaces, hyphens,
slashes, colons, etc.) MUST be enclosed in single (') or double (") quotes. This includes:
  - values with spaces (e.g., `summary = "critical bug"`).
  - values with hyphens such as issue keys, component IDs, resolution IDs, and parent keys
    (e.g., `id = "ISSUE-4"`, `id IN ("ISSUE-4", "DEMO-99")`, `components IN ("CMP-1", "CMP-2")`).
  - date values (e.g., `created >= "2024-01-01"`).
Plain alphanumeric values (e.g., `status = Open`, `priority IN (High, Low)`, `project = DEMO`) may
be passed unquoted; quoting them is also accepted.
Value comparisons are case-insensitive (e.g., `status = "open"` matches "Open").
Field names must match exactly as shown below (e.g., `status` works, `STATUS` does not).

Valid searchable fields (using any other field will raise a ValueError):
- `id` (issue ID, e.g., `id = "ISSUE-123"`, `id = "DEMO-1"`)
- `project` (project key, e.g., `project = "DEMO"`, `project = "PROJ"`)
- `summary` (text, e.g., `summary ~ "critical bug"` or `summary = "Exact phrase"`)
- `description` (text, e.g., `description ~ "detailed steps"`)
- `issuetype` (e.g., `issuetype = "Bug"`, `issuetype = "Task"`, `issuetype = "Story"`)
- `status` (e.g., `status = "To Do"`, `status = "Open"`, `status = "In Progress"`, `status = "Resolved"`, `status = "Closed"`, `status = "Done"`)
- `priority` (e.g., `priority = "Highest"`, `priority = "High"`, `priority = "Medium"`, `priority = "Low"`, `priority = "Lowest"`)
- `text` (searches summary, description, and comments, e.g., `text ~ "critical bug"`)
- `assignee` (username, e.g., `assignee = "jdoe"`, `assignee = currentUser()`, `assignee IN ("jdoe", "asmith")`, `assignee IS EMPTY`)
- `reporter` (username when present, e.g., `reporter = currentUser()` or `reporter = "jdoe"`)
- `labels` (label value, e.g., `labels = "bug"` or `labels IN ("bug", "urgent")`)
- `components` (component ID, e.g., `components = "CMP-1"` or `components IN ("CMP-1", "CMP-2")`)
- `comments` (comment text, e.g., `comments ~ "release blocker"`)
- `fixVersion` (version ID, e.g., `fixVersion = "VER-1"` or `fixVersion IS NOT EMPTY`)
- `resolution` (resolution ID, e.g., `resolution = "RES-1"`, `resolution = "RES-2"`). Use `resolution IS EMPTY` for unresolved issues. Use get_all_resolutions to retrieve available IDs.
- `parent` (parent issue ID for subtasks, e.g., `parent = "PARENT-1"`, `parent IS EMPTY`, `parent IS NOT EMPTY`)
- `created` (e.g., `created >= "2024-01-01"`, `created = "2024-01-01T12:00:00"`). Supported formats: `YYYY-MM-DD`, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffff`, `DD.MM.YYYY`. Unsupported: relative dates ("-24h", "now()"), slash-separated dates ("2024/01/01").
- `updated` (e.g., `updated >= "2024-01-01"`, `updated < "2024-06-01"`). Supported formats: `YYYY-MM-DD`, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffff`, `DD.MM.YYYY`.
- `due_date` (e.g., `due_date >= "2024-01-01"`, `due_date IS EMPTY`). Supported formats: `YYYY-MM-DD`, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffff`, `DD.MM.YYYY`.
- `startDate` (e.g., `startDate >= "2024-01-01"`, `startDate IS NOT EMPTY`). Supported formats: `YYYY-MM-DD`, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffff`, `DD.MM.YYYY`.
- `closedDate` (e.g., `closedDate >= "2024-01-01"`, `closedDate IS EMPTY`). Supported formats: `YYYY-MM-DD`, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffff`, `DD.MM.YYYY`.

Supported operators:
- `=` (equals), `!=` (not equals)
- `~` (contains), `!~` (does not contain)
- `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=` (comparison operators for dates/numbers)
- `IN` (e.g., `priority IN ("High", "Low")`)
- `NOT IN` (e.g., `status NOT IN ("Closed", "Done")`)
- `IS EMPTY`, `IS NOT EMPTY` (for null/empty checks)
- `IS NULL`, `IS NOT NULL` (aliases for empty checks)

Combining conditions:
- Use `AND` and `OR` for multiple conditions (e.g., `project = "DEMO" AND status = "Open"`).
- `AND` has higher precedence than `OR`.
- Parentheses `()` for explicit grouping (e.g., `(project = "DEMO" OR project = "PROJ") AND status = "Open"`).

Ordering results:
- Use `ORDER BY fieldName [ASC|DESC]` (e.g., `ORDER BY created DESC`).

start_at.description: The index of the first issue to return. Defaults to 0.

max_results.description: The maximum number of issues to return. Defaults to 50.

name: start_reindex
description:
Start a reindex operation in Zira.

This method initiates a reindex operation which rebuilds the search indexes in Zira.
The reindex can be performed in either FOREGROUND or BACKGROUND mode with additional
options for indexing specific content types.

reindex_type.description: The type of reindex to perform. 'FOREGROUND' blocks other operations, 'BACKGROUND' runs concurrently.

index_change_history.description: Whether changeHistory should be reindexed. Not relevant for FOREGROUND mode where it's always reindexed.

index_worklogs.description: Whether worklogs should be reindexed. Not relevant for FOREGROUND mode where they're always reindexed.

index_comments.description: Whether comments should be reindexed. Not relevant for FOREGROUND mode where they're always reindexed.

name: update_application_property_by_id
description:
Update an application property in Zira.

This method allows modifying the value of an existing application property
or creating a new one if it doesn't exist.

id.description: The identifier/key of the property to update. Must be a non-empty string. Examples: 'siteName', 'maintenanceMode'.

value.description: The new value to set for the property.

name: update_component_by_id
description:
Update an existing component.

This method allows updating the name, description, and/or owner of an existing
component. At least one of name, description, or owner must be provided.

comp_id.description: The unique identifier of the component to update. Format: 'CMP-{number}'.

name.description: The new name for the component. Cannot be empty or whitespace-only. Maximum length is 255 characters.

description.description: The new description for the component. Pass an empty string to clear. Maximum length is 1000 characters.

owner.description: The new owner username for the component. Pass an empty string to unassign. If provided (and not empty), must be a valid user in the system.

name: update_current_user_preferences
description:
Update the current user's preferences.

Updates the stored theme and/or notification preference values.

value.description: The preferences to update. Must contain one or more of the allowed preference fields.

theme.description: Theme preference. One of 'light' (default light theme), 'dark' (dark mode), 'auto' (follow system preference). Pass None to clear the preference.

notifications.description: The notification preference for the user.

name: update_filter_by_id
description:
Update an existing filter.

This method allows updating various properties of an existing filter including
name, JQL query, description, favorite status, and editability. At least one
parameter (other than filter_id) must be provided for the update to proceed.

filter_id.description: The unique identifier of the filter to update. Cannot be empty.

name.description: The new name for the filter. Cannot be empty if provided.

jql.description: The new JQL query for the filter. Cannot be empty if provided.

description.description: The new description of the filter.

favorite.description: Whether the filter should be marked as favorite.

editable.description: Whether the filter should be editable.

name: update_group_members_by_name
description:
Update the members of an existing group.

This method allows updating the list of users in a specific group.
The group must exist before it can be updated.

groupname.description: The name of the group to update (case-insensitive). Cannot be empty or whitespace-only.

users.description: Complete list of usernames for the group. This replaces all existing members. Duplicates will be removed automatically.

name: update_issue_by_id
description:
Update an existing issue.

        This method allows updating the fields of an existing issue.
Only the provided fields will be updated. Note: if the project field is changed,
existing components, parent, and fix/affected versions that do not belong to the
new project are automatically removed.

issue_id.description: The unique identifier of the issue to update.

fields.description: The fields to update. Only provided fields will be modified. If None, no updates are performed.

description.description: The description of the issue. Pass empty string to clear (clears to empty string "").

priority.description: The priority ID of the issue (e.g., 'Highest', 'High', 'Medium', 'Low', 'Lowest'). Must reference a valid priorities ID in the database. Pass None to clear (clears to None).

status.description: The status ID of the issue (e.g., 'To Do', 'Open', 'In Progress', 'Resolved', 'Closed', 'Done'). Must reference a valid statuses ID in the database. Pass None to clear (clears to None).

assignee.description: Assignee information in dictionary format. Example: {"name": "jdoe"}. Pass None to unassign.

name.description: The assignee's username (e.g., 'jdoe'). Use 'Unassigned' or empty string '' to unassign the issue.

issuetype.description: The issue type ID (e.g., 'BUG', 'TASK', 'STORY', 'SUBTASK'). Must reference a valid issue_types ID in the database.

project.description: The project key. Normalized to uppercase before lookup.

components.description: List of new component IDs associated with the issue. Pass an empty list to clear.

due_date.description: The due date of the issue. Supported formats: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY. Normalized to YYYY-MM-DD. Pass None to clear.

comments.description: A list of comments to replace all existing comments on the issue. Pass an empty list to clear.

labels.description: A list of labels/tags for the issue (e.g., ["bug", "urgent"]). Pass an empty list to clear.

resolution.description: The resolution ID of the issue (e.g., "RES-1", "RES-2"). Use get_all_resolutions to retrieve available IDs. Pass None to clear.

startDate.description: The date when work on the issue started. Supported formats: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY. Normalized to YYYY-MM-DD. Pass None to clear.

closedDate.description: The date when the issue was closed. Supported formats: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY. Normalized to YYYY-MM-DD. Pass None to clear.

parent.description: The parent issue ID for subtasks. Must belong to the same project as the issue. Pass None to clear.

fixVersion.description: List of target fix versions. Each version must exist and belong to the same project as the issue. REPLACES all existing fix versions. Pass an empty list to clear.

items.description: A version reference containing the version ID.

affectedVersion.description: List of affected versions. Each version must exist and belong to the same project as the issue. REPLACES all existing affected versions. Pass an empty list to clear.

items.description: A version reference containing the version ID.

name: upload_avatar
description:
Upload a new avatar to Zira.

This method allows uploading a new avatar image to be used in Zira.
The avatar can be used for users, projects, or other entities.

filetype.description: The type of avatar being uploaded.

filename.description: The name of the file being uploaded. Must be a non-empty string.

username.description: The username of the user this avatar belongs to. Required when filetype is 'user'. Ignored for other filetypes.

project_key.description: The project key this avatar belongs to. Required when filetype is 'project'. Ignored for other filetypes.

name: upload_temporary_avatar
description:
Upload a temporary avatar to Zira.

This method allows uploading a temporary avatar that can be used for preview
before making it permanent. Temporary avatars are typically used during the
avatar selection process.

filetype.description: The type of avatar being uploaded.

filename.description: The name of the file being uploaded. Must be a non-empty string.

username.description: The username of the user this avatar belongs to. Required when filetype is 'user'. Ignored for other filetypes.

project_key.description: The project key this avatar belongs to. Required when filetype is 'project'. Ignored for other filetypes.

name: validate_license
description:
Validate a license key against the database.

This method validates a license key by checking if it exists in the system's
license database and returns the validation status with decoded information.

license.description: The license key to validate. Must be a non-empty string, cannot be whitespace-only.
